about: Every word the site shows that is not already part of a page, a form, the menus or the media list. Keys are permanent; the text is the shipped default, and a published edit from Connect wins over it. Required text cannot be published empty and must keep every {{placeholder}} its default has; text marked optional disappears from the page when published empty.
